title: 106th Rescue Wing Medical Supply Airdrop
description: New York Air National Guard 106th Rescue Wing's 102nd Rescue Squadron, F.S. Gabreski Air National Guard base, Westhampton Beach, N.Y., completed a loadmaster directed rescue drop of medical supplies 1,200 nautical miles off the coast of Long Island, May 20, 2022. The crew of the HC-130J Combat King II search and rescue aircraft were able to successfully find the 32-foot sailing vessel and drop the medical supplies, which were used to help a severely burned passenger on-board. (U.S. Air National Guard photos by SSgt Daniel H. Farrell)
keywords: 106th Rescue Wing, NYNG, 102nd Rescue Squadron, Air National Guard, loadmaster

transcript.text: On May 20th, the one-o-second rescue squadron performed a loadmaster-directed air drop of
medical supplies, 1200 miles off the coast of Long Island to a 32-foot vessel that was
headed from Panama to France when the coast guard was notified of a female passenger on
board receiving second and third-degree burns from boiling water.
